card.name: Digit 4 in 1940s years, and displacement verbs
card.fires_on: The digit 4 in a year in the 1940s (19<<4>>x) in history text. Also fires on a few drug-text words after a drug name or phrase, such as 'from' after 'displace warfarin' and 'distributes' after 'Theophylline'.

modes.label: 1940s years
modes.description: The digit 4 as the third digit of a year from 1941 to 1949 in historical passages.
modes.example: During the 19<<4>>6 national elections, the communists turn

modes.label: Drug distribution and displacement
modes.description: The word 'from' after 'displace warfarin', or the verb 'distributes' after a drug name, in drug interaction text.
modes.example: Aspirin can also displace warfarin<< from>> protein binding sites, leading to prolongation

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the 4 in years like 1945 and on a few words describing how a drug moves or displaces another.
